title: US new visa restriction targets individuals involved in cybercrime
content: The United States has introduced a new global visa restriction policy. This measure targets individuals involved in cybercrime and cyber-enabled offenses. Online investment scams and sextortion perpetrators face these new restrictions. Immediate family members of those responsible may also be subjected to visa limitations. The administration is deploying various tools to dismantle criminal scam networks.

title: Sensex down 900 points, Nifty50 ends below 23,800: Why stock market crashed today

Foreign institutional investors continued their selling trend, impacting market sentiment negatively. Renewed concerns over US trade tariffs also contributed to the overall market decline. Selling in heavyweight stocks like Infosys and HDFC Bank added to the day's losses.

title: Shelter dog Duke lost home, sister and two adoptions before video saved him

A volunteer shared Duke's story online, which reached a woman nine hours away. This woman instantly decided to adopt Duke, bringing him to his new home. Duke now lives a happy life with a family committed to him.

title: Oregon may charge tech firms for undersea cables to fund public schools

Existing fees were established about twenty-five years ago and were much lower.  The new rates aim to attract tech investment while ensuring compensation.  This update follows a 2020 incident involving a cable construction project.

title: Billions wiped out in IBM's worst fall in 115 yrs, but CEO has message for Wall Street

title: BHAVYA Rasayan scheme: Cabinet approves Rs 3,030 crore for three chemical parks

The Bharat Audyogik Vikas Yojana Rasayan scheme will be implemented over five years. The Centre will provide up to Rs 1,000 crore grant for each park. This plan seeks to boost manufacturing, attract investments, and create jobs.
